lead.headline: Russia Launches Ballistic Missile Attack on Kyiv, Injuring Residents
lead.summary: Russia struck Kyiv and the surrounding region with a barrage of ballistic missiles after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky warned of a mass attack. Residents were injured and buildings were damaged.

tech.headline: OpenAI to Change How It Handles Data Center Efforts After Outcry
tech.summary: OpenAI said it will change its approach to data centers after local opposition, including voter rejections of local measures. It plans to pay for its own power and infrastructure and to rebrand the sites as compute campuses.

tech.headline: Claude Can Now Analyze Your Spending With New Personal Finance Tool
tech.summary: Anthropic added a personal finance feature to Claude that analyzes users' spending.

business.headline: U.S. Economy Added 165,000 Jobs in October
business.summary: Employers added 165,000 jobs in October, according to the Labor Department's monthly report. The figures beat expectations and kept the Federal Reserve's focus on inflation.

business.headline: Oil Set for Sharp Weekly Fall as Investors Weigh Iran Conflict After Midterms
business.summary: Oil prices were on track for a steep weekly decline after the midterm elections. Investors weighed hopes for an end to the Iran war against the risk of renewed conflict.

business.headline: Airbnb Shares Jump Over 10% as Third-Quarter Earnings Beat Forecasts
business.summary: Airbnb beat third-quarter estimates for earnings and revenue, and travel bookings rose. Its shares jumped more than 10%.

world.headline: Russia's Land Gains in Ukraine Dwindle as Diesel Reportedly Goes Unsold
world.summary: Russia's territorial advances in Ukraine have slowed, according to analysis of the front lines. Reports also say its diesel exports are going unsold.

world.headline: Israeli Attacks Kill Four in Gaza, Including a Child
world.summary: Four people, including a child, were killed in Israeli attacks on Gaza. The deaths continue a run of lethal strikes during the ceasefire period.

world.headline: U.S.-EU Channel for China Talks Comes Back to Life
world.summary: A dialogue channel between the U.S. and EU on China policy has revived after stalling following President Trump's return to office, according to an SCMP exclusive.

opinion.headline: US Allies Need a Plan for a Lame-Duck Trump
opinion.summary: Champion notes the conventional wisdom that Trump, after losing both houses of Congress, will lash out through foreign policy, where his power is undiluted. He says this has Ukrainians, Iranians and Israelis worried, and that Cuba's leaders should be too. He argues that US allies need a plan for the lame-duck period.
opinion.author: Marc Champion

opinion.headline: Can Religious Democrats Close the 'God Gap'?
opinion.summary: Wear argues that the midterms show the Democratic Party has discovered the power of faith. His column asks whether religious Democrats can narrow the 'God gap' with Republicans.
opinion.author: Michael Wear

opinion.headline: Hey, Fellow Republicans. Tired of Winning Yet?
opinion.summary: Igoe argues that Trump broke his promise that Republicans would win so much they'd tire of winning. He says the 2026 Republican losses rest on the president. He warns that the damage to the party's state and local bench will make 2028 easier for freshman Democrats.
opinion.author: Kevin Igoe

sports.headline: Patriots Rule Out A.J. Brown and TreVeyon Henderson Against Packers
sports.summary: New England's final injury report rules out receiver A.J. Brown and running back TreVeyon Henderson for Sunday's game with Green Bay.

sports.headline: After Short Playoff Runs, How Will the Red Sox Attack an Unusual Offseason?
sports.summary: The Globe looks at Boston's roster questions and the options available after back-to-back brief postseason appearances.

sports.headline: Bruins Beat Penguins 6-2 for Third Straight Win
sports.summary: Pavel Zacha scored twice as Boston won 6-2 in Pittsburgh, according to Yahoo Sports.
